findings.summary: A server-detected incomplete diagnosis never shows the pending-blocks alert. The server sends the 422 as { error: { pendingBlocks, code, message } } (server/services/diagnosisService.ts:85-91 via server/http/errorHandler.ts:77 and sendError), but src/api/httpClient.ts toApiError only copies error.details into ApiError.details. readPendingBlocks therefore reads undefined and cannot list the blocks, so the gate shows nothing (after the local correction it shows only the generic error line). This is outside the unit's write paths: the fix is on the server (nest pendingBlocks under error.details) or in httpClient (keep the extra error keys). Owner: phase-1-backend-diagnoses or phase-1-frontend-primitives; route the choice to integration.

messages.text: The 422 incomplete body is { error: { pendingBlocks, code, message } } (diagnosisService.incomplete -> DomainError details spread by errorHandler.ts:77). The frontend reads error.details.pendingBlocks, and httpClient only exposes error.details. Please nest the list under error.details (for example, have errorHandler send details: error.details) so the gate can list the pending blocks. The frontend already falls back to the generic error line if no list comes back.

Before merging: (1) resolve the 422 pendingBlocks shape finding above (backend nest under error.details, or httpClient keeps the extra error keys). (2) Run pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts once phase-1-backend-diagnoses has landed. (3) Manual pass: Empresa -> 'Começar o primeiro diagnóstico' -> answer one question -> reload #/diagnostico/:id and check the answer and 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM' -> 'Ver meu resultado' with gaps (list and links) -> gate confirm and cancel -> 'Descartar rascunho' confirm and cancel. (4) Decide whether IF-003 gets createdAt so the discard dialog can show the draft's creation date instead of its last save.
